title: The Foreman
reference: repeat 4 { F2 } def F1 { forward jump activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }
hints: Climb the ring and come back down. Every platform is a step, a hop and a switch.
F1 does step, hop, switch. F2 is a side: F1, F1, turn. Main repeats F2.
repeat 4 { F2 } def F1 { forward jump activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }

story.intro: VANTA: "The Foreman runs this floor, and the Foreman answers to me."
story.outro: PATCH: "Workshop's yours. VANTA's gone quiet, which I don't love. Next up: the Control Room."
